result.reason: The redline appropriately extends both licences to Corio’s Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and adds a supporting Affiliate definition. However, Section 2.2 is fully paid-up but still is not expressly irrevocable, so it does not reach the preferred position. The assignment provision also remains subject to consent when the M&A successor is a direct competitor, and therefore does not clearly satisfy even the fallback requirement of transferability to an M&A successor. No subscription licence appears to be implicated. In addition, the new CUSTOMER(S) definition is unnecessary to implement the licence-scope rule and may alter unrelated sublicensing eligibility; it also contains number-agreement defects (“customers…having its…who obtains”).
